sammendrag: The Rate of Exits from Unemployment Towards the End of Unemployment Benefits A Study of Atypical Periods During the Unemployment Episode, by Xavier Joutard and Michèle Ruggiero. This article looks at the imminence of benefit-scheme changes, using the June 1989 Fichier national des allocataires (French national file of welfare recipients). It is considered that the period around a scheme change is an atypical period in the unemployment episode. Duration models are estimated over these particular time intervals. The aim is to identify the characteristics of individuals whose rate of exit from unemployment increases as a drop in replacement income draws near.
tittel: Taux de sortie du chômage à l'approche de la fin des droits à l'indemnisation. Une étude de périodes atypiques durant l'épisode de chômage
